hook: A 13.46‑meter boring machine tunneled 4.5 km beneath the Panama Canal.

sections.voiceover: On 26 Oct 2026 the TBM “Panamá” finished a 4.5 km drive under the Panama Canal. It links Farfán west to Albrook east, the canal’s first underground link.
sections.visual_cue: Map of Panama Canal showing Farfán portal, Albrook shaft, and the 4.5 km tunnel path.

sections.voiceover: But the 13.46‑meter diameter made boring through soft soils a huge challenge.
sections.visual_cue: Close‑up of the TBM cutterhead cutting through soft earth.

sections.voiceover: The Mixshield TBM’s 13.46‑meter diameter and cutter kept the face stable. That stability let the 4.5 km tunnel finish on schedule, breaking at Albrook 26 Oct 2026.
sections.visual_cue: Animation of the completed tunnel with Metro Line 3 trains moving through.

sections.voiceover: The first tunnel under the Panama Canal is complete.
sections.visual_cue: Celebratory shot of the tunnel entrance with the Panama Canal in the background.
